Create variations in collar, bodice, sleeve, skirt and/or pants patterns.
Select appropriate fabric and procedures for a chosen pattern.
Show sewing skills in pattern layout, seam finishes, and collar construction.

programs.title: Viticulture Skills

outcomes: Describe the basic biological processes of plants.
Identify the important vineyard pests and disease problems and be able to suggest correct remedies.
Describe correct sustainable cultural practices for vineyards.
Safely operate small farm tractor equipment

programs.title: Vocational Nursing
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
outcomes: Provide safe, competent patient care at an entry-level for a Vocational Nurse.
Perform safe, patient/client-centered nursing care needed for individuals of all ages with various health needs, considering the continuum of health and illness.
Model ethical, legal, and professional responsibilities within the therapeutic relationships with client families and team members.
Exemplify competent technical and manual nursing skills needed to provide direct patient/ client care.
Satisfy the eligibility requirements for, and take and pass, the National Council Licensure Examination for Practical Nurses (NCLEX-PN).

programs.title: Web Development
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Ensure that plug-ins and scripts avoid common security problems and protect against common attacks.
Construct web content using basic and advanced HTML per current W3C standards.
Make appropriate use of W3C standards-based technology to implement a separation of content from presentation.
Develop responsive, accessible, engaging web content that is effective across different platforms and devices.

programs.title: Word Processing
outcomes: Describe how word processing applications may be used as problem-solving tools.
Apply knowledge of word processing applications to create a variety of documents which include features such as tables, lists, images, references, and watermarks.
